validity.recommendation: Leave Diameter blank as recorded -- Alabama Georgia Connector modifies five existing compressor stations with no new mainline pipe; LengthKnownKm=0 is already correct. No action needed.
validity.researcher_notes: FERC's Notice of Availability of the EA (Docket CP23-194, https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2023/12/01/2023-26463/transcontinental-gas-pipe-line-company-llc-notice-of-availability-of-the-environmental-assessment, fetched and read directly) itemizes the complete facility list: re-wheel two compressors at CS90 (Marengo Co AL); upgrade two gas turbines +3,685 hp at CS110 (Randolph Co AL); re-wheel three compressors at CS115 (Coweta Co GA); replace a 12,000-hp electric compressor with a 22,500-hp unit at CS120 (Henry Co GA); re-wheel one compressor and uprate a 9,000-hp unit to 15,000 hp at CS125 (Walton Co GA); plus 'station piping within the compressor stations listed above' -- all five sites are EXISTING stations, and the only piping mentioned is in-station, not a new mainline segment. Second, independent source: Marcellus Drilling News' contemporaneous headline and coverage ('FERC Approves Ala. Georgia Connector to Upgrade 5 Compressors') confirms the same compressor-only scope with no pipeline diameter mentioned (https://marcellusdrilling.com/2024/03/ferc-approves-ala-georgia-connector-to-upgrade-5-compressors/). Per the standing compression-only rule, the sheet's blank Diameter is the correct, confirmed value.
